agreements.title: Lista Dogovora
agreements.review: Reviewed: person-led open appointment rows, full visible schedules, separated totals and the existing rating/completion attention targets. Internal fixtures; no command executed.

agreement-waiting.title: Dogovor koji čeka potvrdu
agreement-waiting.review: Reviewed: real presentation component with inert data; next action precedes the accepted record, total is distinct and the fixed completion control is visible. No completion submitted.

agreement-long.title: Dogovori: dugačak naslov i termin
agreement-long.review: Reviewed at ordinary size: long name wraps, overnight term and timezone remain complete, long work title fits three lines, people and total remain visible.

cards.title: Kartice zadataka
cards.review: Reviewed: offers and per-person examples have green work titles, illustrated facts, a separated terms band and publisher portraits. Per-person capacity wraps onto its own line. Fixtures are not live jobs.

discovery.title: Zadaci: mapa i otvorena lista
discovery.review: Reviewed read-only: real open-list sheet uses the bare card without a nested raised frame. Map tiles and selected Tasks navigation are visible. This capture does not verify pin accuracy, selection or Nearby.

detail.title: Detalj zadatka
detail.review: Reviewed read-only: real public task shows green heading, complete visible logistics before the offers band, publisher, description and fixed application entry. No application or other mutation was sent.

agreement-history.title: Dogovori: istorija i nedostajući iznos
agreement-history.review: Reviewed: history selection is visible; missing term and missing price use words. A cancelled record does not present a fabricated amount.

agreement-narrow.title: Dogovor: 320dp i font 1.3
agreement-narrow.review: Reviewed at 320dp/font 1.3: long name, full overnight schedule and timezone, location, people and total reflow. The list work title uses its existing three-line ellipsis; this is not a claim that every title is fully visible. Normal design baseline remains font 1.0.
agreement-narrow.note: Bounded resilience view; ordinary density 420 and font 1.0 remain the visual baseline.
